central pivot with metal rivet
fan blades have metallic silver finish
wooden ribs connecting blades to handle
fan blades fan out from central pivot

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect color (metallic parts are dark gray/black instead of silver) and simplified geometry. Model B has incorrect color (metallic parts are dark gray/black instead of silver) and missing details like the central pivot and handle texture.

Model A has incorrect base color (darker gray) and handle shape (thinner, less rounded). Model B has similar issues but with slightly better handle shape, while both lack the reference's metallic base sheen and have less accurate handle proportions.
